universe: All 12 frozen 2021 CPI releases from the existing BLS manifest.

event_source_hierarchy.source_family: Danske Bank Weekly Focus / issue-specific static Danske research PDF
event_source_hierarchy.rule: Use the latest qualifying issue strictly before T0 that contains all four required CPI consensus fields.

event_source_hierarchy.source_family: Reuters pre-release poll/reporting, including verbatim Reuters syndication on public mirrors
event_source_hierarchy.rule: Only when no qualifying priority-1 record exists. Use the latest qualifying Reuters publication strictly before T0 that explicitly contains all four required CPI consensus fields.

snapshot_rule: Within a source family, latest qualifying pre-T0 publication wins. Earlier qualifying versions are preserved but never averaged.
timestamp_rule: publication_timestamp_utc < T0; same-day evidence requires explicit/resolvable clock. Earlier-date issue-specific static PDFs may pass through auditable edition identity.
version_rule: Preserve URL/article or issue identity, publication date/time, retrieval time and content/normalized-evidence hash. Mutable historical calendar rows do not qualify.
conflict_rule: No averaging. Higher-priority qualifying source wins prospectively. Conflict is recorded, never used to source-shop.
missing_rule: Any missing one of the four fields leaves the event incomplete.
note: Frozen after preserving the Danske-only 7/12 coverage failure and before researching Reuters coverage for the missing CPI events.
